title: Stopping is part of finishing
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Define the promised outcome — Name what the work must let someone do.; Check use and failure — Verify the consequential paths.; Record remaining limits — Make deliberate boundaries visible.; Deliver and maintain — Stop this phase with a route for future revision..
